purpose: Matched Gaussian PPO pilot of existing relative-position input conditioning; no action or feature-information change.
checkpoint_selection: First saved checkpoint at/above 50k, within one full 2560-slot rollout; retain exact live counts.
capacity_control: Same local inputs and 170-dimensional architecture, parameters, full initial tensors, and Gaussian exploration. Multiply existing x_r/y_r by 20 in one arm only.
learning_control: Each run is evaluated against its own saved zero-experience policy; paired initial behavior must be identical.
primary_contrast: For each metric: (trained - own initial) with scale 20 minus (trained - own initial) with scale 1.
aggregation: One exploratory training seed. Report both arms and all checkpoints; no across-seed or generalization claim.
resource_policy: One simulator worker, sequential arms; existing evaluators are preserved. Do not launch before the rescaling integration succeeds.
limitations: One training seed, 100k live transitions, and twenty repeatedly used development worlds.
The diagnostic gradient shares are not causal feature importance and do not prove a scaling problem.
Both actor and critic receive the rescaling; this is not an actor-only intervention.
Initial full tensors and neutral actor distributions match, but initial critic predictions need not match.
Fixed route guidance and static guards supply support; aircraft-conflict filtering stays disabled.
The wider Gaussian pilot failed the multi-metric screen; use the same 0.05 Gaussian standard deviation in both arms here.
Classical data are the preserved fixed Windows benchmark from an earlier evaluator revision.
Unseen streams and official evaluation remain reserved; the cluster static-support bundle is unchanged.
failure_behavior: Stop this coordinator on a failed check or incomplete budget, preserve every artifact, and do not restart automatically.
initial_control: Full initial policy tensors and Gaussian action distributions match; the changed inputs can affect initial critic values.
